search.head: Find anything in a second
search.line: Every chat, note and file your team has touched is one search away.
brief.head: Start each day already briefed
brief.line: {chief} reads your calendar and inbox overnight and hands you one page at 8.
hire.head: Hire a teammate for any job
hire.line: Describe the job in one sentence and {chief} sets up a bot with the right skills.
drop.head: Drag notes straight in
drop.line: Drop a PDF, a photo or a page of notes on any chat and your team reads it at once.
needs.head: Approvals wait in one place
needs.line: Anything that needs your word lands in Needs you, ready to answer in one click.
needs.try: Open Needs you and press Allow
routines.head: Routines run on their own
routines.line: Give a job a time and it happens every day, week or month, no reminders needed.
routines.try: “Every Friday at 5, send me the week's numbers”
byname.head: Ask a teammate by name
byname.line: Start with @{m2} and it goes straight to them, with {chief} kept in the loop.
voice.head: Talk instead of typing
voice.line: Hold the mic and speak. Your words land as text, ready to send.
voice.try: Hold the mic and say what you need
today.head: Today shows what is moving
today.line: One calm page: what needs you, what is on, and who is working on what.
levels.head: Set how much each bot asks
levels.line: Each teammate runs on Ask or No limits. On Ask it checks with you before anything leaves this computer.
levels.try: Settings, then a bot, then its level
phone.head: Your team in your pocket
phone.line: Pair your phone and message any teammate from anywhere. Answers land here too.
phone.try: Settings, then Phone, then scan the code
notify.head: Hear back the way you like
notify.line: A finished job can reach you as {surfaces}. Pick any mix.
surfaces.mac: a banner, a badge or a quiet pill
surfaces.win: a toast, a taskbar badge or the tray
surfaces.other: a notification, a badge or the tray
